## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature / enhancement
- [ ] Chore / infra / docs

## Checklist
- [ ] Branch name follows `feat/`, `fix/`, `chore/`, or `docs/` prefix convention
- [ ] Commits use Conventional Commits format (`type: description`)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes locally
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] No personal data added (names, roll numbers, seat lists, merit lists)
- [ ] New `exclude` / `excludePrefixes` entries added for any stale or personal-data documents found during crawl
- [ ] Crawl changes tested with `npm run crawl -- <uni-id>` before opening PR
